h1: Seacrest Beach "Amazing Grace" 8915 E Co Hwy 30A
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Amazing Gulf views- Short walk to the deeded beach access- Conveniently located a mile from Alys Beach and The Hub- Complimentary Peloton Bike - an Alaya exclusive amenity- Private pool **Pool heating available October 1 - May 1 for $100 per day** - Sonos sound system- Shuffleboard table- Elevator- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- 8 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Indulge in complete coastal luxury at Amazing Grace, a Seacrest Beach home enjoying Gulf views and sleeping 24 guests in exquisite comfort with 8 bedrooms, 8 bathrooms, and 3 half baths. Imagine slow-paced afternoons lounging in the private pool, sipping cocktails on the balcony, playing shuffleboard, or strolling to the beach—only 1 minute away!Calming artwork, pale hardwood floors, and white shiplap walls define this 3-level home’s refined interior. Savor days of fun in the first-level game room, equipped with a bar, a 65” Smart TV, and a shuffleboard table. French doors invite guests onto the covered back porch, where ceiling fans and a Sonos sound system provide ultimate comfort. Grill lunch at the outdoor kitchen and dine poolside surrounded by scrub oaks and palm trees, while the cascading waterfall feature provides a serene soundtrack. At bedtime, 2 guest bedrooms with king beds and 1 guest bedroom with 2 full beds provide comfy accommodations.Take the stairs or home elevator to the second floor’s bright and open great room. A serene kitchen with premium appliances has everything guests need for crafting decadent delicacies. Dine at the table for 8 before adjourning to the living space, furnished with matching sofas and 2 plush armchairs surrounding a 55” TV. Double French doors open to a balcony with sprawling views and a staircase to the pool deck below. Opposite the living area is an inviting primary bedroom with a king bed and balcony access.The third-floor landing hosts a beautiful sitting area with bamboo chairs and leads into a second living space with a wraparound couch, armchairs, 75” Smart TV, a wet bar, beverage cooler, and awe-inspiring Gulf views from the balcony. Sleeping accommodations include a bunk room with a twin-over-twin and full-over-full bed, alongside a guest bedroom with a king bed.Guests needing additional privacy will appreciate the 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom Carriage House. The cozy living area has a queen sleeper sofa, a 75” TV, and connects to a full kitchen. Both guest bedrooms have king beds.Enjoy an indulgent escape at Amazing Grace. Luxurious amenities include dedicated beach access and a Peloton exercise bike. On-site parking, 8 complimentary adult bikes, and a 6-passenger low speed vehicle make exploring fun and convenient. Book todaySLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 24):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Two Full Beds, Shared Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo- Half Bathroom: Toilet OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower and Tub Separate- Half Bathroom: Toilet OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Twin over Twin Bunk Bed and Full over Full Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower Only- Half Bathroom: Toilet OnlyCARRIAGE HOUSE:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower Only- Living Area: Queen Sleeper SofaWeddings are not allowed at this home.
